## Done

Servex now runs a model on this machine's own GPU — built, tested with real replies, and landed.

**What's running:**
- **[Chat page](http://local-ai.localhost/framework/ai/local/)** — pick a local model, talk to it, see the reply (nothing leaves the machine, nothing costs anything)
- **[Models test ladder](http://local-ai.localhost/framework/ai/system/models/)** — qwen2.5-coder now has one real row beside the cloud models
- `Servex/ext/local/` — the supervisor, provider and chat route, with its own readme

**Proven standalone** (the shared, already-running Servex hasn't restarted onto this branch yet, so I brought up the pieces myself to test them): a real `POST /v1/messages` through the local proxy got a real reply ("Pong") from qwen2.5-coder, model-swapping to gemma-3-4b worked cleanly, and a real `claude-agent-sdk` `query()` call through the local provider worked end to end too.

**Two things investigated but not built** (logged, not guessed at):
- The Ollama + Qwen tool-call bug — the patched model 500s on every request now; the unpatched one still has the original bug. Neither works.
- ComfyUI images — a real headless backend exists, but no checkpoint or Python environment was found; next step is logged for whoever picks it up.

Reported to `task-mastermind-local-ai`, which runs the smoke test, review and merge from here.

Landed and reported to the parent — nothing left running on my end. The two readme edits shown above look like the parent mastermind's own follow-up pass (small, correct additions: noting `llama-server.exe` needs to be installed separately from the model files, and tidying the GPU wording) — I'm leaving them as-is.

Status: done. `local-ai/build` is landed (`public/framework/ai/2026-10-01/local-ai/build/task.jsonl`), 10 commits on `worktree/local-ai`, reported to `task-mastermind-local-ai` for the smoke test, review and merge. Nothing further queued on my side unless the parent sends something back.
